caseNameFull: Apollo Steel Co. v. Burnet, Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Paul Armitage for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Youngquist and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Sewall Key, John MacC. Hudson, and W. Marvin Smith for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for a writ of certiorari herein is denied because of failure to file the petition within the time prescribed by the statute.
